title: Start-of-shift line check
description: The checks a bottling line runs before the first production bottles are released.
safety_notes: Lock out the filler and the capper before reaching into either.

steps.title: Line clear
steps.instruction: Check the line is clear of the last run's bottles, caps and labels.

branches.condition: Something from the last run is still on the line

steps.title: Clear the line
steps.instruction: With the line locked out, remove everything from the last run, then check again.
steps.safety_note: Lock out the conveyor before reaching in.

steps.title: Check the carbonation
steps.instruction: Take a bottle from the filler discharge and read its carbonation.

steps.title: Adjust the carbonation
steps.instruction: Adjust the carbonator to the line's setting, run ten bottles to drain, then retest.

steps.title: Check the Brix
steps.instruction: Read the Brix of the same sample on the refractometer.

steps.title: Adjust the syrup ratio
steps.instruction: Adjust the syrup ratio to the line's setting, run ten bottles to drain, then retest the Brix.

steps.title: Hold the batch
steps.instruction: Stop the line, tag the batch on hold and call the shift supervisor.

steps.title: Check the fill height
steps.instruction: Measure the fill height of three bottles from the finish and enter the lowest.

steps.title: Adjust the filler
steps.instruction: With the filler locked out, set the fill tubes to the line's height, then measure again.
steps.safety_note: Lock out the filler before reaching into the bowl.

steps.title: Photograph the first bottles
steps.instruction: Photograph the first bottles off the capper, label side facing you.

steps.title: Check the cap torque
steps.instruction: Measure the removal torque of one cap on the torque tester.

steps.title: Adjust the capper
steps.instruction: With the capper locked out, set the capping head to the line's torque, then test again.
steps.safety_note: Lock out the capper before reaching into the head.

steps.title: Check the label
steps.instruction: Look at the label on the first bottles: placed straight, skewed, or missing?

branches.condition: The label is skewed or missing

steps.title: Adjust the labeller
steps.instruction: Reset the labeller's guide and glue, run ten bottles, then look at the label again.

steps.title: Record the date code
steps.instruction: Scan or type the date code printed on the first bottle.

steps.title: Release the line
steps.instruction: Release the line for production once the shift lead has looked over the record.
